description: ADR 0050 §2 (amends ADR 0023), RFC 7518 §8.8: max_pbes2_count bounds the sum of p2c over every PBES2 candidate tried in one decrypt call. For a general JWE (RFC 7516 §7.2.1) with two kid-less PBES2-HS256+A128KW + A128GCM recipients of p2c 6000, a decoy password first and this password second (built with Node.js 24.21.0 node:crypto (OpenSSL 3.5.8) from SHA-256-derived bytes), the first candidate uses 6,000 of the default 10,000 and the second would need 6,000 more, so it is never tried: DecryptionFailed
